title: Kosmesis components.json
description: Per-project configuration written by `kosmesis init` and read by `kosmesis add`.

style.description: Component visual style variant. Currently always "default".

styleSystem.description: Which styling system this project's components are written against.

css.description: Path to the project's global stylesheet (styleSystem: "tailwind") or generated theme module (styleSystem: "praxisjs-css"), relative to the project root.

registry.description: Registry base — a local directory path or an http(s):// URL serving `<styleSystem>/<name>.json` files.

registries.description: Additional registries keyed by "@namespace", resolved when a component is addressed as "@namespace/component" in `kosmesis add`. Managed via `kosmesis registry add|remove|list`.
